removal.heading: Group removal management
removal.description: When a recipient sends one of the keywords, their number is automatically added to the removal list and a confirmation message is sent to them.
removal.warning: Changing this setting overrides the general default. Incorrect words may prevent the automatic removal of recipients who requested it — you are responsible for making sure the words fit all your bots.
removal.autoRemovalHint: When turned off, no automatic removal will occur on your bots, even if the keyword is set.
removal.hebrewMessagePlaceholder: Message sent to a recipient who wrote a Hebrew keyword
removal.englishMessagePlaceholder: Message sent to a recipient who matched an English keyword
removal.disableWarningLine1: Under anti-spam and privacy protection regulations, recipients must be able to remove themselves from distribution lists.
removal.disableWarningLine2: Disabling automatic removal releases the system from responsibility — the responsibility for handling removal requests transfers to you fully and personally.
removal.disableWarningAck: By clicking "I acknowledge and accept responsibility" you confirm that you have read the warning above and accept full legal responsibility for handling removal requests.
removal.confirmSaveTitle: Confirm saving the custom removal setting?
removal.confirmSaveBody: This setting will override the general default for all your bots. Missing words may prevent automatic removal of recipients who requested it — this is your responsibility.
removal.confirmRevertBody: Your custom setting will be removed, and all your bots will go back to using the keywords and message defined in the system.
